images.caption: U.S. Army Maj. Gen. Robert G. Catalanotti, left, the U.S. Central Command director of J7, exercise and training shakes hands with Kuwaiti army Maj. Gen. Abdulrazaq Al-Awadhi, the Kuwait Armed Forces assistant chief of staff for operations and plans with the Kuwait Ministry of Defense, after signing an agreement for Eagle Resolve, at a signing ceremony in Kuwait City, Kuwait, Oct. 31, 2013. Eagle Resolve is an annual multilateral exercise designed to enhance regional cooperative defense efforts of the Gulf Cooperation Council nations and U.S. Central Command. The exercise, hosted by Kuwait, is scheduled to occur during the first quarter of 2015, at the Kuwait Ministry of Defense, and will include sea, air and land components with the potential to involve up to 35 partner nations. (DoD photo by Sgt. Adam C. Keith, U.S. Army/Released)

images.caption:
Shuwaikh (Arabic: الشويخ) is a part industrial and part rural area within the Al-Asimah Governate in the country of Kuwait. The majority of Kuwait's ports and several offices reside in the area.

This area also contains the  Friday market ( Souq al-Juma) at Al-Rai place (Fourth Ring Road). It starts every Thursday in the afternoon and goes until Friday evening. You can find used stuff and new stuff, clothes, designer clothes, Materials to make clothes, furniture, carpets, animals, plants, antiques and souvenirs,... You DO need to bargain or you get cheated.
images.alt:
